_comment: The creatures that fly, as `fish` is the ones that swim.
A ninth umbrella word, and the first to ask `aloft` -- a tag the derivation has carried since the tag pass
and no word had reached for. The shape is the one every umbrella word has: restrictive, aimed at the
spawns, one tag and nothing else, so what it finds moves with the derivation rather than with a list here.
It finds two offline -- the bat and the phantom -- and that is a fact about `aloft` rather than about
this word. The tag derives from `MobCategory.AMBIENT`, which is the bat and nothing else, so the bee,
the parrot, the allay, the ghast, the blaze and the vex all fly and none of them carries it. That is the
usual shape of a rule that is nearly the fact it stands for, and the answer is the one `grazing` already
took: the category says what it can, and the rest is hand-authored. It belongs to the tag pass.
